text:
sam: quick sanity check before i merge the sa/auth refactor — main worry is jwt audience + impersonation for multi-project clients. Anyone hit weird 403s in the node sdk after swapping flows? pinging @jen @elaine :eyes:

elaine: saw one in staging yesterday, 403 when aud was project-scoped (we set aud to the project id). fixed by setting aud to the impersonation service client id. weird but reproducible.

jen: we shouldn’t rely on project ids in the aud. recommended pattern: aud -> impersonator client id (or the static impersonation audience) and send target project via header/claim. what exact change did you make, sam?

sam: i switched to emitting the raw SA jwt as bearer and then call /v1/impersonate?target=project:bar. snippet: 
```
const tok = await getServiceAccountJwt({aud: `project:${proj}`});
await fetch(`${IMPERSONATE_URL}?target=${target}`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${tok}` } });
```
staging logs then show: "aud mismatch" from impersonation service.

mike: FYI the impersonation endpoint validator expects aud to be either the static_impersonate_audience OR the impersonator client id. we added that tighten last quarter to avoid token reuse. if you use an oauth/token style exchange, aud should be `https://oauth2.redwood.example.com/token`. could be a mismatch between expected formats.

carol: our docs have a few patterns but they’re inconsistent. the blurb suggests setting aud to the impersonation service URL which i agree is confusing. we should centralize the guidance: "use impersonator client id as aud + include target_project claim".

jen: action items: sam open a small PR to default the node sdk to impersonator client id for aud when the impersonation flow is chosen; make it opt-out (config flag). ela ine, can you add a short clarifying note in devex docs about aud expectations for dedicated/private deployments?

elaine: yep will add a snippet + example curl. also will throw a logging hint into the impersonation service so it returns a clearer error on aud mismatches (e.g., HTTP 403 with body: `{"error":"aud_mismatch","expected":"impersonator-client-123"}`).

mike: small implementation note — watch out for the case where aud is an array (GCP token shape). our validator currently takes the first element; add tests for empty array and multiple entries.

jen: +1 to tests and e2e. please include a minimal e2e that runs impersonation against local stack (docker compose), otherwise we keep hitting odd staging-only flakes.

sam: will open PR today and link the e2e. cc @mike for review. i’ll also add a short migration guide in the SDK changelog.

deploy-bot: auth-service/staging scheduled: v1.12.3 deploying at 2024-04-12T15:30Z :rocket: (track: https://deploys.redwood.example.com/auth-service/staging/12345)

sam: thanks all — filing followups: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/2345 (auth-aud-clarify) and PR draft github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3456. will ping when PR ready for review.

mike: i can review later today. tiny nit: add unit tests for jwt parsing edgecases (empty aud array, multiple audiences, aud as number).

carol: when you open the docs PR, add the curl example like: 
```bash
curl -X POST "${IMPERSONATE_URL}?target=project:bar" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SA_JWT}" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

jen: thanks — this should remove a lot of flakiness. once PR merges let's cut a patch release and note the migration steps in the release notes. :tada:

sam: will do. tagging this thread as done-for-now, will update when PR is up.
